\smallskip
\noindent\textit{Instructions: Answer any \textbf{five} questions. All questions carry equal marks. Symbols have their usual meanings.}
\bigskip

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 1.}
\begin{parts}
  \item Evaluate the following C expressions (assume \texttt{int} arithmetic):
  \begin{parts}
    \item \texttt{15 - 10 / 3}
    \item \texttt{10 / 4.0 - 2 * 5}
    \item \texttt{5 / 3 - 2 - 5 * 2}
    \item \texttt{-3 \% -8 / 2 + 7}
  \end{parts}\pts{7}
  \item With the help of examples, explain numeric, character, real, alphanumeric, and string constants in C. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 2.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of a program, explain the use of increment (\texttt{++}) and decrement (\texttt{--}) operators. Write a C program to find the maximum of three numbers. \pts{7}
  \item Write the basic data types used in C. Also explain enumerated data types with an example. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 3.}
\begin{parts}
  \item What is the purpose of the \texttt{for} statement? How does it differ from the \texttt{while} statement? Explain with the help of a program. \pts{7}
  \item Write a C program to perform the $t$-test for testing equality of two means. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 4.}
\begin{parts}
  \item Explain the use of \texttt{break}, \texttt{continue}, and \texttt{goto} statements with the help of a program. \pts{7}
  \item With the help of a program, explain the use of the \texttt{switch} statement in C. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 5.}
\begin{parts}
  \item Define one-, two-, and multi-dimensional arrays in C. Write a program for multiplication of two matrices. \pts{7}
  \item Write a C program for fitting a straight line $Y = a + bX$ by the method of least squares. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 6.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of a program, explain automatic, static, and external variables in C. \pts{7}
  \item Explain functions with arguments and return values. Write a C program to find the median of $n$ given numbers using a function. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 7.}
\begin{parts}
  \item What do you mean by recursion? Write a C program for the generation of the Fibonacci series using recursion. \pts{7}
  \item Write a C program for calculating the Karl Pearson correlation coefficient using a function. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 8.}
\begin{parts}
  \item Define structure in C. Write a C program to show the use of structures. \pts{7}
  \item Describe unions in C. Write the similarities and differences between structures and unions, with a program demonstrating the use of a union. \pts{7}
\end{parts}
